$comment: Phase 1 resolved config. AskQuestion unavailable (don't ask mode); defaults from deep_research_prompt.json carried forward without user-side clarifications. Sub-questions are the orchestrator's decomposition; the user can refute them in a follow-up run.
query: What concrete, implementable changes to the SAD (Stakeholder-Anchored Development) v0.1 methodology repository (C:/SAD) would most lower the activation energy for a first-time adopter — solo developer, small team, or maintainer of an existing repo — to start using SAD on a real project, while preserving SAD's central novelty (the three-tier audience model in NOVEL.md §1 and the Reconcile-as-numbered-phase invariant in NOVEL.md §2)?
context: SAD v0.1 OSS methodology kit at C:/SAD. ~20 docs, ~20 slash commands, ~20 personas, 4 eval-suite skeletons, 5 descriptive hook JSON files, 4 bash scripts, 1 worked example. README routes to 1357-line user guide; no QUICKSTART/CHEATSHEET/installer/cross-platform scripts/turn-key assistant adapters/Level-0 maturity entry.

decomposed_sub_questions.text: Which artifacts in the current SAD kit are the largest contributors to time-to-first-observable-win, and how would the SAD maintainers measure that empirically?
What progressive-disclosure shape (quickstart, cheatsheet, installer, more worked examples, video) is most consistent with 2025-2026 published evidence on developer-methodology adoption?

How should SAD adapt when the three human tiers collapse to one solo developer without collapsing into spec-theatre or losing the Virk & Liu (arXiv 2508.06484) protection that motivates the three-tier audience model?

Which AI-coding-assistant integrations (Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, Codex, Windsurf) should ship as turn-key adapters, and what does each adapter need to contain in concrete terms (rule files, command files, hook wiring, settings)?
What falsifiable adoption signal(s) should the SAD maintainers measure within 90 days post-change to know whether any specific change actually moved time-to-first-observable-win?

clarification_answers.question: Sub-question coverage / web budget / idea count
clarification_answers.answer: AskQuestion unavailable in this environment (Claude Code don't-ask mode). Defaults applied: 5 sub-questions retained; max_web_searches=12; min_novel_ideas=4 / max_novel_ideas=7. User may refute in a follow-up run via /genIdeator handoff.
